# Deployment Regulations
These are non-modifiable SOP's that cannot be changed unless approved by a member of Provost.
- Medical, Requisitions and CIC must have at least one member of their department on the ship/installation for any other members of their department to deploy. - Deployment of staff should never be done if it would leave their department understaffed. - IO, EO, Engineering Technicians, Synthetics and General Infantry are the only permitted personnel to deploy before a FOB has been established and secured.
## Command Staff - The Commander may deploy to the FOB and to the frontline so long as the XO is stationed within CIC. - The Executive Officer may deploy to the FOB and to the frontline so long as the CO is stationed within CIC. - Staff Officers may deploy to the FOB and to the frontline with XO/CO permission, so long as CIC remains adeqadequately staffed. - Advisors may deploy only to the FOB and doing so only for training purposes.
## Department Heads - CMO, CMP & LO are prohibited from deployment. - IO may deploy freely to the FOB and the Frontline only to collect intelligence. They should avoid direct engagement. - EO may deploy freely to the FOB and to any secure area for engineering purposes. For example, maintaining generators, communications arrays or reinforcing an area.
## Medical Staff - Nurses & Doctors may only deploy to the FOB with permission from the CMO or XO/CO.
## Logistics Technicians - Logistics Technicians may only deploy if their department is manned by another member of their department for delivering resupplies only to the FOB. - They may utilize drones for deployment of resupplies to the frontline.
## Engineering Technicians - Follow EO deployment regulations.
## Military Police - Military Police may deploy to the FOB with permission from the CMP or XO/CO. - When conducting a field arrest, Military Police must follow the procedures outlined in [textlink="UCMJ Arresting Procedures." link="AU14UCMJArrestingProcedure"]
## Flight Crew - All Pilots & Dropship Crew Chiefs may only deploy to the FOB. - Gunship Pilots and its crew may briefly enter frontlines via rappels for delivery of supplies, rescuing wounded or other emergency tasks.
## Synthetics - May be deployed to the FOB or Frontline depending on orders.
## General Infantry All listed personnel below are covered as general infantry and are expected to deploy. - Squad Leaders - Fireteam Leaders - Drone Operators - Weapon Specialists - Vehicle Crewmen - Vehicle Commanders - Hospital Corpsmen - Radio Traffic Operators - Automatic Riflemen - Combat Technicians - Riflemen
